name: Default
shortDescription: Scanopy server that maps hosts, services and subnets reported by its scanning daemons into live network topology diagrams, with a bundled PostgreSQL database.

alerts.message: Register the first account right after deployment: it creates the only organization on the server, and later users need an invite to join.

This template runs the server only. Nothing is scanned until you create a daemon under Discovery > Daemons and install it on a host inside each network you want to map; in the default mode it connects outbound to this server's URL.
